newsitem.title: USA: Iomega in new $200 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Iomega in new $200 mln credit facility.

text.p: Iomega Corp said Monday it has entered into a new $200 million senior credit facility with a syndicate of 17 financial institutions.
The maker of computer storage products said the new senior credit facility is a revolving line of credit with a three year term and will be used for general corporate purposes.

It replaces Iomega's previous $100 million line of credit, which was not utilized at the time of closing, and Iomega's $35 million European accounts receivable asset securitization facility, which has been terminated.
J.P. Morgan Securities Inc and Citicorp Securities Inc worked as the lead arranger and co-arranger, respectively, of the bank syndicate.
